text.p: The Jakarta stock exchange suspended trading in small-sized plastics manufacturer PT Langgeng Makmur Plastic Industry just before the close on Friday after a sharp drop in the firm's stock, an exchange official said.

"The exchange has suspended Langgeng. This time the suspension was due to sudden sharp drop. Last Tuesday the stock was also temporarily suspended due to a sudden sharp rise," one exchange official said.
Langgeng Makmur fell 275 rupiah to 975 rupiah, with some 4.9 million shares traded, before it was suspended at around 0850 GMT, shortly before the close of trading, the official said.
The exchange had resumed trading in Langgeng on Wednesday afternoon before it was suspended again in late Friday trading.
Brokers said the sharp fluctuations in the stock was largely due to speculation.
